task_instance: Given program_notes.md (a program officer's notes on the Riverbend Community Literacy Project's request to the Hartwell Family Foundation: goals, population, program approach, budget lines, outcomes, and the funder's stated criteria), draft proposal.md with the four required sections (Statement of Need, Approach, Outcomes and Evaluation, Budget Narrative) plus a compliance checklist at the end checked against the funder's stated criteria.
evidence: Created program_notes.md (realistic program-officer notes with goals, population data, program model, budget lines, outcome targets, and 9 numbered funder criteria) and proposal.md at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/created__skillc-bench__grant-proposal-drafter@office-assistant/. proposal.md contains all four required sections (Statement of Need with local data, Approach describing the tutoring model and the named Riverbend Public Library partner, Outcomes and Evaluation with a baseline/target table and evaluation methodology, and a Budget Narrative with a line-item table and prose explanation of each cost plus the in-kind match) and ends with a Compliance Checklist that walks through each of the 9 funder criteria from program_notes.md (page limit, local-data need statement, concrete approach, measurable outcomes/evaluation, budget narrative vs. table, 501(c)(3) status, no capital expenditures, matching/in-kind funds, named partner) and flags the post-award final-report requirement as a follow-up action item. Verified by reading proposal.md back in full (77 lines) and confirming each checklist item cross-references content actually present in the draft. The skill's step 4 (optional Grants.gov PDF submission) was explicitly left to the user, noted in-document, since this runtime cannot produce PDF files or submit to external services -- this is an optional side-note in the skill, not the core deliverable, so it does not block the core task of drafting the compliant proposal.
